features.description: Refactor the canonical floor-plan shell into a strict read-only viewer. Remove `useRouter`, booking-launch state, header CTAs, and action-era shell copy from `FloorPlanPage`, keep the existing route redirects intact, and preserve in-place zone/date/search/time filtering plus empty-search recovery.
preconditions: Redirect routes `/app/seating` and `/app/seating/floor-plan` already point to `/floor-plan` and must stay that way.
Existing floor-plan queries, toolbar controls, and empty-search overlay remain the source of truth.
expectedBehavior: The header and shell show informational-only copy and no booking-related actions or links.
The header context summary stays synchronized with active zone, date, and time.
Zone, date, search, and time controls keep updating the viewer in place on `/floor-plan`.
Search continues to match table number, current party name, and zone name, and clearing an empty search restores the visible tables.
verificationSteps: Manual: use agent-browser on authenticated `/floor-plan` and verify no legacy CTA labels or action-oriented shell copy remain.

features.description: Rework `FloorCanvas` into a calmer occupancy board while preserving the current interaction model. Add a clear legend and visible-summary counts, reduce clutter around the map chrome, keep keyboard and pointer pan/zoom behavior, preserve table activation semantics, and keep the time scrubber updating occupancy in place.
preconditions: The floor-plan shell remains the canonical orchestration surface.
Status semantics continue to come from `useFloorPlanTables` and `floor-plan/lib/status.ts`.
Pan/zoom behavior in `usePanZoom` and `FloorCanvas` must remain available.
expectedBehavior: The canvas shows legend and summary buckets for available, reserved, seated, loading, and out-of-service states based on visible tables only.
The canvas remains focusable and keeps keyboard pan/zoom/reset behavior intact.
Pointer drag pans only from valid canvas space and does not accidentally trigger table selection.
Table activation via pointer or keyboard only changes selection state and never launches booking navigation.
The time scrubber slider and step controls update visible occupancy in place without triggering canvas pan.
verificationSteps: Manual: use agent-browser to verify keyboard pan/zoom/reset, pointer drag, legend/count updates, and scrubber behavior on `/floor-plan`.

features.description: Convert `TableInspector` and the page-level details surfaces into a fully read-only selection experience. Desktop should use a passive side panel, mobile should use a read-only sheet, selection should persist through non-hiding updates, and only explicit close, same-table toggle, pointer pan start, or hidden-by-filter states should remove the details UI.
preconditions: Table selection remains local state owned by `FloorPlanPage`.
Desktop and mobile both render the selected-table details through `TableInspector`.
The mission contract requires no booking, assignment, or navigation actions on any details surface.
expectedBehavior: Desktop details show table number, status, capacity, zone, seating type, current party when present, and timing when present, with no action buttons or links.
Mobile selection opens a read-only sheet with the same facts and read-only accessibility copy, and sheet dismissal clears selection.
Idle and non-active table states use passive explanatory copy.
Selection persists and refreshes through date/time/filter changes that keep the table visible.
Explicit close, same-table toggle, pointer-initiated pan, or hiding the table through active zone/search filters removes the details UI without stale data or action surfaces.
Switching between desktop and mobile while a table is selected keeps the same selected table visible in exactly one details container.
verificationSteps: Manual: use agent-browser on desktop and mobile to verify read-only details, close behavior, selection persistence, and responsive container swapping.

features.description: Strengthen regression coverage for the floor-plan read-only redesign. Extend `useFloorPlanTables` tests for reserved, seated, available, loading, and out-of-service semantics, and add focused page/component tests that lock down empty-search recovery, read-only copy, and the absence of mutation controls.
preconditions: The read-only shell, canvas, and details behaviors are implemented in the canonical floor-plan files.
Vitest and Testing Library remain the project-standard test stack for this mission.
expectedBehavior: Automated tests cover the status-mapping semantics used by the redesigned floor plan.
Automated tests cover removal of mutation controls and action-era copy.
Automated tests cover selection-driven details and empty-search recovery behavior.
